# Chandra Kant Budhalakoti

> Frontend Engineer with 2.5 years of experience building production web applications with Vue.js, Nuxt, React, Next.js and TypeScript. Based in Haldwani, Uttarakhand, India.

## About

Chandra Kant Budhalakoti is a Frontend Engineer at Trigital Technologies Pvt. Ltd. (Hyderabad, remote; Apr 2024 – Present), currently building the frontend for CiteMentor AI, an AI product under Trigital. Previous work there includes a Jira/ClickUp-style task tracker, a tenant management system, Vue/Nuxt e-commerce storefronts, multilingual chatbot systems and the Trigital Technologies marketing site. Strengths: component architecture, state management, REST integration, SSR strategy and web performance.

## Selected Projects

- CodeTakhti — Free, open-source, mobile-first online code editor and compiler for 11 languages, running in the browser on WebAssembly (Next.js, TypeScript, Monaco). Live: https://codetakhti.vercel.app/ · Source: https://github.com/ChandrakantBudhalakoti/js-ts-playground
- PDF Lab — Open-source PDF processing platform: merge, split, compress, convert, watermark, lock, unlock (Next.js, Express, TypeScript, Docker, qpdf, Ghostscript, ImageMagick). Live: https://pdf-lab-alpha.vercel.app/ · Source: https://github.com/ChandrakantBudhalakoti/pdf-lab
- CiteMentor AI — Frontend for an AI product at Trigital (Vue.js, React); 20+ reusable components, 35% smaller initial bundle.
- RAG Pipeline API — PDF question answering with sources using LangChain, PostgreSQL/pgvector and OpenAI or Gemini (Python, FastAPI). Source: https://github.com/ChandrakantBudhalakoti/pdf-rag-api-template
- Enterprise Task Tracker — Jira/ClickUp-style project management across 6 dashboard views (React.js, Next.js, TypeScript).
- Production E-Commerce Platform — Vue/Nuxt storefront; SSR lifted Lighthouse performance from 61 to 92.
- AI Powered Chatbot Platform — Multilingual chatbots across 4 business domains and 3 languages (Vue.js).
- Trigital Technologies Website — Company site with 95+ Lighthouse SEO and accessibility (Next.js, Tailwind CSS).
- CodeQuest — Gamified programming lessons with quizzes and puzzles (Next.js, Zustand). Live: https://codequest-ashen.vercel.app/ · Source: https://github.com/ChandrakantBudhalakoti/codequest
